name: Guatemalan midwife breastfeeding support
description: A 2015 UNICEF report describes Guatemala’s breastfeeding-support initiative for traditional midwives, with health-service staff in 25 municipalities trained for subsequent knowledge exchange.

impact.note: One recent training initiative in 25 municipalities, a modest improvement in local support with no successors known yet.

date.label: 2015 report
date.basis: Publication date of the report documenting the initiative and training milestone.

events.statement: A 2015 UNICEF report describes Guatemala’s breastfeeding-support initiative for traditional midwives, with health-service staff in 25 municipalities trained for subsequent knowledge exchange.

evidence.supports: The 2015 report describes Guatemala’s midwife breastfeeding initiative in 25 municipalities and four departments. Health-service personnel had completed training and were prepared to exchange knowledge with midwives; certification was projected, not established.

events.caveats: The report states health-service personnel had completed training and were prepared to exchange knowledge with midwives; it does not establish that midwife training or certification was completed, or report infant health outcomes. The report also describes implementation in 15 municipalities elsewhere, whereas its summary and training milestone refer to 25; the discrepancy is unresolved.

measures.conditions: The summary and staff-training milestone refer to 25 municipalities, while another passage says implementation in 15. This discrepancy is unresolved; the figure is not a count of midwives, families served or measured coverage.
